result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_edge()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get an edge object by an edge ID. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L2899-L2939){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_edge(edge_id) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Retrieves the `Edge` object for the specified edge ID. The `Edge` object contains id, source, target, weight, and attributes properties. Returns `None` if edge doesn't exist. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [edge_id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Edge ID to retrieve. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Edge | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `Edge` object or `None` if not found. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} `get_edge()` looks up an edge by its ID and returns the underlying `Edge` object, whose `source`/`target` are resolved node IDs rather than the original labels: ::: {#17a6d33a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_node("A").add_node("B").add_edge("A", "B", weight=1.5, type="friend") edge_ids = graph.get_edge_ids() edge = graph.get_edge(edge_ids[0]) edge.source, edge.target ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (1, 2) ``` ::: ::: `weight` and `attributes` are also available directly on the edge: ::: {#7f2e43a7 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} edge.weight, edge.attributes ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` (1.5, {'type': 'friend'}) ``` ::: :::
